o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish ایل (ẹl), from Proto-Turkic *ēl.
From Proto-Common Turkic *tālak, from Proto-Common Turkic *tāl (“spleen”).
From cazibə + -dar. Compare Ottoman Turkish جاذبهدار, Uzbek jozibador.
From first-person singular past simple of sıçmaq (“to shit”). A calque of Persian ریدم (ridam, literally “I shat”).
